messages.content: What year was the law of universal gravitation published by Isaac Newton?

function.name: publication_year_find
function.description: Fetches the year a particular scientific work was published. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

author.description: Name of the author of the work.

location.description: Place of the publication, if known. Default to 'all'.

message.content: Isaac Newton’s formulation of the **law of universal gravitation** appeared in his seminal book *Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica* (“The Mathematical Principles of Natural Philosophy”), which was first published in **1687**.
message.reasoning:
We need to answer "What year was the law of universal gravitation published by Isaac Newton?" The user asks about the year when Newton's law of universal gravitation was published.

Newton first formulated his theory of gravity in Principia Mathematica (Mathematical Principles of Natural Philosophy). It was published in 1687. So we can respond with that. But maybe they want the year it was published as part of Principia or earlier? He also wrote some early papers on gravitational attraction but the main publication was 1687. We should provide that and perhaps mention the Principia. No tool needed because it's common knowledge. We'll just give an answer.
